decisions.statement: Every file the tree holds is judged.
Nothing under the index is judged, because no page owns what the index derives.
A file git ignores is judged only where a page holds that file uncommitted.
A file's owner is worked out from that file's name against what the page types declare.
A page's own file is owned by that page.
A file whose name carries a page type is owned by the page that name states.
A file a page type names is owned by a page of that type in the folder where that name begins.
Everything beneath a folder a page type names is owned by the page naming that folder.
A file closing with an extension a page type names is owned by the page naming that extension.
A file whose name states a page that is nowhere is let through.
A file some page owns is let through, whatever that file holds.
No list in this check names a file let through.
A page a change adds owns the files that same change gives that page.
Every file a page's code imports is owned by a page.

definition: the check refusing a file that belongs to no page
